summary: Both candidates fail. GLM preserves most prose but corrupts names, formulas, dates/page provenance and every crop; Haiku drops readable solutions and heavily corrupts statements. Corrected transcription checked against all three source pages, all ten candidate crops, and all seventeen checker findings; catalogue provenance remains explicitly escalated.
